source.title: [P1][Accessories] Separate retail accessory sales from repair-parts usage using one stock ledger
source.body:
Part of JD epic #2, using private flat-file architecture adopted in #4. Extends existing JD-specific functional issues instead of duplicating them.

## Goal
JD needs sales of compatible phone/laptop accessories and spare-parts sourcing, not just materials consumed during repair. Keep retail and service inventory linked but commercially distinct.

## Implementation and data model
Public accessories catalogue in `data/records/accessories.json` and JSON Schema (SKU, category, title, brand, compatibility claims with verification flag, optional approved product media, status, description, customer inquiry CTA). Non-secret catalogue can be versioned in Git; private actual quantity, supplier buy costs, customer sales, price/discount snapshots and warranty/return information must remain in durable private store. Owner UI: retail enquiry -> reserved item -> price quote/sale -> receipt -> fulfilled/returned or cancelled. Reuse existing #6 inventory movements for receipt/reserve/sell/return/repair consumption with unique references; no direct quantity overwrite. Keep separate `retail_sales`, `sale_items`, `sale_payments`, `stock_movements` collections and immutable quote/receipt snapshots, paise INR; distinguish customer accessory sale from service job estimate and part consumed on repair. Product pages are enquiry-first initially; no unapproved cart, online checkout, payment gateway or delivery guarantee.

## API/CLI contract
GET /api/v1/public/accessories; GET/POST /api/v1/admin/retail-sales; POST /api/v1/admin/retail-sales/:id/reserve; POST /:id/complete; POST /:id/return; GET /api/v1/admin/inventory/availability.

## Acceptance criteria and failure cases
Two concurrent reservations cannot oversell; sale and repair use same available-to-promise stock without double count; return replenishes only confirmed reusable units; no product price, stock claim or compatibility published without approval; all money/stock movement audited and idempotent; no public customer PII in catalogue.

## Dependencies
#17 registry, #18 store, #19 API, existing #6 inventory, #8 finance and #7 repairs.

## NEBO reference
NEBO ProductService, OrderService, Stock-related order snapshots; adapt to JD accessories + repair parts, not generic e-commerce shipping.

## Non-negotiables
TypeScript/JavaScript server logic; JSON data + JSON Schema, YAML config/collection metadata, Markdown publishing, Mermaid diagram source. Public repository has NO customer/device/payment data or secrets; private writes occur only in authenticated durable storage; implement tests, docs/AGENTS consistency, safe browser QA and verified deployment gates. Never provision paid services, transmit real customer messages or publish unapproved prices/claims without owner authorization.
